The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2f19b2f37c05dcf9), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. statement: Let T be a smooth connected compact Kähler manifold, B ≥ 0 a rational simple normal crossing divisor with coefficients less than one, and M a nef rational line bundle. Suppose J = KT + B is pseudo-effective. There are a smooth compact Kähler modification µ : U → T, a semiample rational line P on U, and an effective rational divisor R on U, such that µ∗ (J + M) ≡ P + R, R = N c1(µ∗ (J + M))  . Here ≡ denotes equality of real Chern classes. Moreover, if a(T) = 0, then c1(M) = 0.
